title: ISM Services PMI (Apr 2027 data), 10:00 ET
source: EST: ISM publishes the Services PMI at 10:00 ET on the third business day of the month — the derivation this calendar's six existing services entries already carry (ism-services-2026-09-03, -2026-10-05, -2026-11-04, -2026-12-03, -2027-01-07, -2027-02-03), and the one the ism-services-2027-02-03 lane corroborated against an ISM primary: the 2026 annual seasonal-factor announcement (PRNewswire, 2026-01-29) states the changes were effective with 'the January 2026 ISM Services PMI, which was released on February 4, 2026', and 2026-02-04 is February 2026's third business day. May 2027's first three business days are Mon 2027-05-03, Tue 2027-05-04 and Wed 2027-05-05: 2027-05-01 is a Saturday, none of the three is a US federal holiday, and the NYSE trades normal sessions on all three. Not January, so the fourth-business-day January exception the ism-services-2027-01-07 lane established does not apply. ismworld.org was re-probed direct 2026-09-09 and returned HTTP 400 at the end of an eleven-hop self-referential redirect chain under a browser user-agent, so no 2027 ROB calendar could be read and the prefix stays EST:. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of ism-manufacturing-2027-05-03
notes: DISCOVERED in the adjacency sweep of ism-manufacturing-2027-05-03, and it closes the same year-boundary gap its manufacturing sibling did: this calendar tracks ISM services monthly through 2027-02-03 and then stops, at the point a prior session's corridor ended rather than at any analytical judgement. Filed at impact high to match the six existing services entries. Note the corridor geometry this entry completes, which is the reason the manufacturing lane proposed it: May 2027's first three sessions carry ISM Manufacturing + SLOOS + Treasury borrowing estimates on Mon 05-03, nothing tracked on Tue 05-04, and ISM Services + the Treasury quarterly refunding statement (08:30 ET) on Wed 05-05 — so BOTH ISM prints of that month share their session with a Treasury refunding-week release, and neither can be read cleanly from a close-to-close move. The manufacturing ledger measured the consequence for its own date and declines to attribute; the same caution transfers here and is the first thing that entry's initial research should test. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
